uncertainty.independent_unit: Curve/instance within each bit size, n=10. Average costs across its three paired seeds first. No pseudoreplication of the resulting 120 seed workloads. Different sizes are separate strata.
uncertainty.primary_parameter: Median across the stated instance-generation population of the paired instance log2 complete-cost ratio. Also report every instance and the fixed-panel total; no average-cost claim is inferred from a median.
uncertainty.interval: For each size sort the ten instance log2 ratios; report [minimum,maximum] as a conservative distribution-free median confidence interval. Under independent instances from the frozen population its coverage is at least 1-2/2^10=99.8046875% (ties conservative). Bonferroni across the four sizes gives simultaneous coverage at least 99.21875%, exceeding 95%. Do not present narrower unregistered seed-level intervals.
uncertainty.aa_floor: For each instance compute absolute log2 baseline-A/A2 cost ratio after averaging paired seeds. The per-size floor is their maximum. Exact deterministic count disagreements trigger instrumentation invalidity rather than a wider tolerated margin. Wall-time spread is diagnostic, never an S threshold.
uncertainty.multiple_size_rule: After all gates, a size supports a scoped median complete-cost improvement only if its simultaneous lower interval endpoint is strictly above its predeclared A/A floor, every target verifies, and fixed-panel total S_candidate < S_base. At least one qualifying size is a scoped incremental success; report all four sizes including nonqualifying results, no selective pooled claim. A four-size general improvement requires all four qualify.
uncertainty.failure_rule: If any paired solve fails/censors, no finite mean-complete-S win is assigned at that size. Report success rates and censored phase costs explicitly; a future cost/success analysis needs its own frozen definition.
uncertainty.power: No guaranteed power: no expected effect/variance model is supplied. This conservative n=10 design is a bounded falsifiable first panel; no post-hoc sample extension or threshold relaxation.
uncertainty.rho_rule: Rho is the long-term distance comparator. Candidate need not beat rho to constitute verified improvement over the current matched IC baseline.
